description: This file defines a command handler class for processing delete cashier allocation commands within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is annotated to handle 'TELLER' entity delete actions, delegating the operation to the 'TellerWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: DeleteCashierAllocationCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service implementing the handling of delete cashier allocation commands, delegating to the corresponding teller write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a delete cashier allocation command by invoking the write platform service to perform the deletion.
